chapter: Leaving the band, Strayhorn and reflections
title: Once-in-a-lifetime players
summary: Greer says Hodges, Carney, Lawrence Brown, Hawkins and Ben Webster cannot be duplicated.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: But you know, although many bands have tried to duplicate the sounds of Ellington, and many guys have
tried to play like Johnny Hodges, Willie Smith and others, --
Every time -- every now and then one comes along, once in a lifetime. There's no more Johnny Hodges. There's -- baritone player, not another baritone player like Carney.
And Lawrence Brown, take a trombone and play clarinet parts. He done it in our band.
Yeah, I know, you told me that.
Hawk, Ben Webster and those guys, they're once in a lifetime. You know.
